name: TrafficSignsTest Driving License Helper
author: niazi123

sections.description:
TrafficSignsTest Driving License Helper is a lightweight WordPress plugin that displays three simple, clearly labeled buttons on any page or post:

  • Verify License – sends the visitor to the official Verify License page on the Punjab Driving License Information Management System (DLIMS).
  • Track Application – sends the visitor to the official Track Application page so they can check their application status.
  • e-License – sends the visitor to the official e-License page to apply for a learner, regular, or international driving license.

The plugin does not collect, store, or process any personal data, CNIC numbers, or license details. It is purely a navigation helper: every button takes the visitor straight to the relevant page on the official Government of Punjab DLIMS website (dlims.punjab.gov.pk), where the actual verification, tracking, and application steps take place.

This is useful for blogs, informational sites, and resource pages that write about driving licenses, traffic rules, or DLIMS in Punjab and want to give readers a fast, reliable way to reach the correct official page instead of searching for it themselves.

Features

  • One simple shortcode: [pdls_license_services]
  • Toggle each of the three cards on or off from the settings page
  • Customize the heading and intro text shown above the buttons
  • Choose whether links open in the same tab or a new tab
  • Set a custom button color to match your theme
  • Clean, responsive card layout that adapts to mobile screens
  • No tracking, no external scripts, no data collection

Disclaimer

This plugin is an independent, unofficial tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Government of Punjab, the Driving License Information Management System (DLIMS), or the Dastak program. All license verification, tracking, and application processing happens entirely on the official dlims.punjab.gov.pk website; this plugin only provides convenient links to it.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly through the Plugins → Add New screen in your WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings → License Services to customize the heading, intro text, and which cards are shown.
  4. Add the shortcode [pdls_license_services] to any page or post where you want the buttons to appear.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin verify licenses itself?

No. The plugin only links to the official DLIMS pages for verification, tracking, and e-License applications. All processing happens on the government website.

Does the plugin store any personal data?

No. The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any user data. It only renders links based on the settings you choose.

Can I change the destination URLs?

Yes. The Verify License, Track Application, and e-License URLs can each be edited from the settings page in case the official website structure changes in the future.

Can I hide one of the three buttons?

Yes. Each card (Verify License, Track Application, e-License) can be shown or hidden independently from the settings page.

Is this plugin affiliated with the Government of Punjab?

No. This is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Punjab or DLIMS.
